choices.text: Let them talk. People say more to a listener than to a question.
Nod, and keep your own counsel.

nodes.text: Why should you meddle with what does not concern you?
This gentleman asks me for information, which common politeness will not permit me to refuse.
As he descended the staircase, Morrel met Penelon, who was going up.

title: Jacopo — a captain with his own deck
